name: Guinglain

attributes.attribute: a knight of Arthur and son of Gawain
the son of the hag Ragnell
a famous knight of the Round Table

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Guinglain was a knight of Arthur and a son of the Round Table. His father was the famous knight Gawain. His mother was the hag Ragnell, freed from a spell by her true love. Guinglain carried the blood of both magic and knightly honour. The romances give him a place among the king's companions.

okr.objective: Trace the lineage of the knight Guinglain.
key_results: Name Guinglain as a knight of the court.
Set out his father Gawain and his mother Ragnell.
Tell of the hag set free by a true love.
Note the blood of magic and honour in him.
